name: Suzanne
summary: Text-to-3D and photo-to-3D: textured 3D meshes (GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX) from a prompt or 1-4 photos.

api_key.description: A Suzanne API key from the console (console.suzanne3d.com); sznn_test_ keys are sandbox, sznn_live_ production. Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Generation is asynchronous: a submission returns 202 {job_id, status: queued}; poll suzanne.jobs.get every 5-10 s until done, failed or cancelled. Typical latency is 30 s to 2 min for one photo, 1 to 4 min for multi-view; give up after 20 minutes.
Models: sculptor (default choice; text, 1 photo or 2-4 photos), atelier (premium PBR; text or 1 photo; glb/fbx), capture (exactly 4 photos front/back/left/right; no text).
Pricing is set per account (ask Suzanne for the rate sheet); billable_amount_cents is on the job. Failed jobs are refunded.
Default limit is 10 concurrent jobs; above it a submission gets 409 concurrent_limit_reached. Send an Idempotency-Key header (kept 24 h) to retry submissions safely.
Multi-view photo jobs need images uploaded first through POST /v1/uploads (a presigned PUT flow not covered here); a single photo can go inline as base64.

endpoints.name: Generate a 3D model from text
endpoints.summary: Submits a text-to-3D job; returns a job_id to poll.

prompt.example: a low-poly forest dragon, game-ready, mossy bark texture

params.description: {faces: 200000|500000|1000000|2000000 (default 500000), pbr: true, quad: false, texture_quality: standard|detailed}. Quad meshes cap at 150000 faces and come as FBX.

outputs.description: Any of glb, obj, stl, fbx; default [glb].

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes the submission safe to retry; same key with a different body gives 409.

notes: A read over POST that is billed per job at the account's rate.

endpoints.name: Generate a 3D model from photos
endpoints.summary: Submits a photo-to-3D job from one inline photo or 1-4 uploaded views; returns a job_id to poll.

model.description: sculptor (1-4 photos), atelier (1 front photo) or capture (all four views).

images_inline.description: {front: <base64 JPEG or PNG>}, up to about 5 MB; single photo only.

images_upload_ids.description: {front, back, left, right} upload ids (upl_...) from POST /v1/uploads; front is required. Use exactly one of images_inline or images_upload_ids.

params.description: Generation parameters: faces, pbr, quad, texture_quality (see suzanne.model.from_text).

outputs.description: Any of glb, obj, stl, fbx; default [glb].

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes the submission safe to retry.

notes: A read over POST that is billed per job. A failed job's error.code may be missing_image, insufficient_views or vendor_*.

endpoints.name: Get a job's status and outputs
endpoints.summary: Status (queued, running, done, failed, cancelled) and per-format download URLs when done.

endpoints.name: Get a download link for a finished model
endpoints.summary: 302 redirect to a fresh 15-minute presigned URL for one output format.

format.description: A format the job listed in outputs.

notes: The answer is a 302 whose Location header is the presigned file URL (valid 15 minutes; call again for a new one). 409 job_not_done until the job finishes.

endpoints.name: Cancel a job
endpoints.summary: Best-effort cancel of a queued or running job; refunded if it stops in time.
notes: already_terminal true means the job had already finished; nothing changed.
